decision.reason: W7-04 runtime implementation is blocked, so no trustworthy media Artifact can yet enter a family; generic W2-C relation authority is necessary but does not express the W7-05 family and lifecycle invariants

dependencyFacts: W2-C ArtifactRelation authority Store API SDK control page and tenant evidence are integrated GREEN
W2-D ImpactPreview and ProductionStart authority is integrated before the current AOS-000030 baseline
the W7-04 contract baseline is approved but its media executor fenced lease checkpoint and takeover implementation remains blocked
W7-05 therefore may align contracts but may not implement or manufacture media runtime evidence
verifiedFoundations: one canonical aip_artifact row per produced immutable-content reference is reused instead of creating a Workshop payload store
ArtifactRelation supports family_member variant_of supersedes and derived_from relation types
both endpoints are tenant scoped and relation creation is idempotent
relation creation revalidates both exact artifact content hashes
database and Store reject self reference and directed relation cycles
relation rows are append-only and preserve the old edge
canonical HTTP API strict SDK parser and AIP production-contract control page expose generic relations
focused W2-C contract and API tests are GREEN
blockers: W7-04 is not GREEN and cannot yet produce trustworthy Master or Variant artifacts
aip_artifact has no first-class revision family identity family revision or family head authority
aip_artifact content_hash remains nullable and the base table has no database append-only guard
generic relation DTO has no explicit artifact role such as preview draft master variant approved or executed
no invariant requires each Variant to reference exactly one compatible Master in exactly one family
no invariant constrains supersedes to the same family artifact type role profile platform and rendition specification
no family-head CAS or fork decision prevents two concurrent successors from both becoming current
generic cycle validation is shared by all relation types but type-specific direction cardinality and transitive rules are absent
family membership does not bind exact Stage attempt source template capability provider policy license Eval and evidence lineage
Preview Draft Approved and Executed are not separately bound to immutable Artifact ImpactPreview Approval StartDecision Action and Receipt exact refs
approval of one exact Variant is not protected from later Master Variant or relation drift
list API returns a tenant-wide relation collection without family root filter stable family topology or pagination contract
no Workshop media family projection timeline or user-visible current versus historical Variant semantics exist
no org-org media family positive path or dev-org isolation canary proves Master Variant supersedes and old-Variant preservation

targetBoundary.artifact: continue using canonical append-only aip_artifact content references; make immutability enforceable before treating it as a revision authority
targetBoundary.family: add the minimum reviewed family identity head and typed invariant contract; do not encode family state only in metadata or UI
targetBoundary.relations: retain ArtifactRelation as the lineage edge authority and add relation-type-specific validation rather than a second Workshop lineage store
targetBoundary.lifecycle: preview draft approved and executed remain distinct exact references and decisions; no mutable status field may overwrite an old Variant
targetBoundary.approvalExecution: approval binds one exact artifact hash; execution consumes that approval through canonical Start Action Lease Receipt authorities
targetBoundary.projection: Workshop reads a reconstructable family topology and timeline but stores no independent business truth

tests.initialAttempt: uv default cache was outside the writable sandbox and failed before collection; it was not counted
tests.meaning: generic ArtifactRelation DTO Store hash cycle idempotency API and route foundations are stable; this does not prove W7-05 family invariants or media lifecycle

next: align W7-05 contracts and checklist through two review rounds, retain the item unchecked, then preflight W7-06
safety: w1-aip uncommitted work was not read or modified; only committed m1 facts were inspected
